_marker: The one F1 outcome recipe:f1:check cannot reproduce offline: a Figma mint refusal. Recorded verbatim; removed the moment the archetype mints (then the fidelity manifest carries its rows).
message: in set_effects: Property "effects" failed validation: Unrecognized key(s)
cause: recipe/figma-writer-runtime.ts sets showShadowBehindNode on every shadow; Figma accepts that key on DROP_SHADOW only and refuses the paste on the box's INNER_SHADOW ring (.rt-BaseCheckboxRoot::before, styles.css). The fixture compiled at a fixed point (30 read, 5 reviewed, 0 invented); nothing on the canvas was written.
fix: fix/writer-inner-shadow (PR #82): one conditional in the shared runtime — and because every boilerplate writer embeds that runtime, a thirteen-writer remint round before it can merge.
